data.message: I individually commit to 18 tons this month, not contingent on unanimity. All 24: opt in to 18 for $8,000 more now than 10 if fulfilled. Assuming k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock may be 100. This is not guaranteed best long-term. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Fisher23/18/25/09, help recruit. Each person: exact intended catch, and any conditions?
